subject: Urban Planning
title: The I-81 Debate in Syracuse
description: One-minute skill: The I-81 Debate in Syracuse.

hook.text: Syracuse, New York is tearing down I-81 — a highway that split the city and destroyed its Black neighborhood.

buildup.text: Built in 1959, the highway demolished the 15th Ward, scattering a thriving Black community of 2,600 families.

discovery.text: The viaduct is now structurally failing. The city must choose: rebuild the highway or remove it entirely.

twist.text: Suburban commuters want the highway rebuilt. City residents want a boulevard. The debate lasted 20 years.

climax.text: In 2023, demolition began. A boulevard with parks will reconnect the neighborhood the highway divided.

punchline.text: It took 64 years to undo what took two years to build.

quiz.question: What happened to Syracuse's 15th Ward when I-81 was built?
options: It was preserved as a historic district alongside the highway
A thriving Black community of 2,600 families was demolished and scattered
Residents were relocated to new public housing near the highway
